verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies recurring execution. TruffleHog Enterprise is described as continuously monitoring Git, Jira, Slack, Confluence and other sources, and continuously tracking key status, using deployed hosted or self-hosted scanners. No evidence shows user-defined schedules, cron-style configuration or workflow orchestration, and the open-source CLI appears to run as one-off or hook-triggered scans. Missing for 10: documented scheduling configuration (intervals/cron), user-defined recurring workflows, open-source scheduling support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
